filing_office: District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection, Corporations Division
filing_fee_notes: DLCP calls this the Certificate of Organization in its fee schedule; its formation guidance calls the filing Articles of Organization, DLC-1.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a commercial or noncommercial registered agent with a physical DC street address. A P.O. box, third-party mailbox or out-of-District address is not acceptable.
expedite_options: Walk-in one-day service adds 100 to the regular filing fee.
annual_report_due: April 1 of the calendar year after registration, then April 1 every two years.
state_tax_registration_agency: District of Columbia Office of Tax and Revenue
unemployment_insurance_agency: District of Columbia Department of Employment Services, Office of Unemployment Compensation
plain_english_summary: File the formation document and maintain a DC registered agent. File the first biennial report the following year.
common_mistake: Waiting two years to file the first biennial report.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. BOSS is the portal identified by DLCP for filing and entity searches. Standard processing time, applicable franchise-tax treatment, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
